whenToUse: A table of contents that marks which section of a long scrolling panel is in view
Jump links that scroll their content to the chosen section and keep that link highlighted

whenNotToUse.when: A bounded panel that only needs its own scrollbar, with no links following the content
A chat transcript that opens on the newest turn and follows replies as they stream
Account pages whose side links swap in one panel at a time, hiding the rest

agentNotes: Without `targetRef` the spy tracks nothing and a click only marks its link without scrolling, so always pass one
`targetRef` can sit on a wrapper around a `ScrollArea`: the spy finds its `scroll-area-viewport` slot and tracks and scrolls that
`history` is on by default, so mount and every section change rewrite the URL hash with `replaceState`; pass false to leave it alone
